title: Three Types of Calibration with Properties and their Semantic and Formal Relationships
reasoning: The paper is a theoretical and mathematical exploration of calibration definitions in machine learning systems. It provides a formal framework to unify disparate notions of calibration using properties and loss functions. While it uses concepts such as 'trustworthiness' and 'fairness' to contextualize the work, it does not evaluate, benchmark, or study religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
